scope: Offline evidence triage and blinded human review preparation. No labels adjudicated, retraining, threshold change, live model change or promotion.
padding_analysis: All799 static images, new model only. Saved COCO categories1/2 map to internal0/1. Paired padding labels include losses and gains.
probe_selection: Highest unpadded matching confidence among test hit-to-miss images. Diagnostic worst case, not a performance estimate.
blind_selection: Window17 only; hash rank independent of predictions/outcomes. Round-robin60/30/15m, max2 endpoints per symbol, same-symbol visible intervals disjoint. Never change train/val/test splits.
qualification: Not individual human gold until completed review; sampled top-gainers snapshot remains a biased universe. No market FPR until adjudicated.
blind_sample_count_policy: Target up to24 unique cases. Actual shortfall must be retained; temporal exclusions and max2per-symbol are hard constraints.
